title: Build the reported question
instructions: Put the words in the right order to make a reported question. Be careful: there is **one word too many** in each task.
hint: Subject before verb – and no *do / does / did* or question form.

items.answer: Mila asked where the cafeteria was.

items.direct: Tyler to Mila: "Do you play soccer?"
answer: Tyler asked Mila if she played soccer.
Tyler asked Mila whether she played soccer.

items.direct: Sofia to Mila: "What did you do at the weekend?"
items.answer: Sofia asked Mila what she had done at the weekend.

items.direct: Diego to Mila: "Can you help me with my German homework?"
answer: Diego asked Mila if she could help him with his German homework.
Diego asked Mila whether she could help him with his German homework.

items.direct: Mrs Moreno to Diego: "When will you be home?"
items.answer: Mrs Moreno asked Diego when he would be home.

items.direct: Mila to Aisha: "Have you ever seen snow?"
answer: Mila asked Aisha if she had ever seen snow.
Mila asked Aisha whether she had ever seen snow.
